domain_setting: A tidy home kitchen and neighborhood bakery with wooden worktops, ceramic plates, flour, bread, baking ingredients, herbs, spice dishes, and unmarked jars. Keep food shapes clear and appetizing.
recurring_scale_anchors: 304x192 card with essential content inside x=24..280 and y=16..176
Use pale kitchen wall, warm counter, ceramic dishes, and simple kitchen utensils
Distinguish breads, desserts, herbs, and condiments by shape, texture, and serving form
No readable labels, text, numbers, logos, or package marks

polysemy_resolution_table.roll (bread): A small round bread roll in the bread group, not the verb meaning turn or move.
polysemy_resolution_table.pepper: Black peppercorn spice in the herbs-and-spices group, not a bell pepper.
polysemy_resolution_table.salt: Seasoning salt in the spices group; ignore the unrelated acronym expansion in the Japanese gloss.
polysemy_resolution_table.cereal: A breakfast cereal served in a bowl, with grain flakes as the visual cue.
polysemy_resolution_table.oil (cooking): Cooking oil in a small pourable bottle, not petroleum or machine oil.
polysemy_resolution_table.flavorings: Cooking flavor extracts and aromatics used in food, represented by unmarked bottles and vanilla pod/citrus peel cues.
polysemy_resolution_table.butter: Butter as a cooking spread or ingredient in this food chapter, not an unrelated verb.

contrast_notes.bagel / bread / croissant / roll / toast: Bagel is a ring-shaped bread; bread is a sliced loaf; croissant is a laminated crescent; roll is a single round bun; toast is browned bread slices.
contrast_notes.noodles / pasta / spaghetti: Noodles are broad curled strands in a bowl; pasta is a mix of dried shapes; spaghetti is long thin strands twirled on a plate.
contrast_notes.cake / cheesecake / cupcake / cookie / p: Use layer or filling, serving shape, and dish style to separate each dessert.
contrast_notes.ice cream / mousse / sorbet / meringue: Ice cream is a creamy scoop; mousse is an airy chocolate dessert in a cup; sorbet is a bright fruit-ice scoop; meringue is a crisp white baked shell.
contrast_notes.basil / chives / cilantro / dill / mint: Use leaf shape, stem form, and aroma cues to make the fresh herbs distinct.
contrast_notes.jam / marmalade / chutney / honey: Jam is smooth fruit preserve; marmalade shows orange peel; chutney is chunky; honey is golden and viscous.
contrast_notes.ketchup / mustard / mayonnaise / soy sau: Differentiate sauces by color, consistency, and unmarked bottle or dish silhouettes.
